title: devctl configuration
description: Schema for .devctl/config.yaml (and merged modular YAML). Unknown fields are rejected at load time.

http.description: Named outbound HTTP recipes. Modular files: .devctl/http/<name>.yaml

redact.description: Mask credentials in logs, traffic, LLM payloads, and env output. Default true. false stores and shows captured values; already masked history is not restored.

path.description: JS/TS module loaded when the supervisor starts

sources.description: Optional sources added to the always-on set (process, secrets_env, defaults, vars, profile_service, runtime). Typical: profile, dotenv, generated, keychain, sops, secret_manager

sops.description: Decrypt a SOPS file when environment.sources includes sops. Plaintext stays in memory.

file.description: SOPS-encrypted file relative to the repo root (JSON, YAML, or dotenv). Required when sops is listed in sources.

input_type.description: Overrides format detection from the file extension

key_map.description: Env var name to SOPS key. Mapped SOPS keys are not also injected under the raw key name.

command.description: argv list preferred; a string is split on whitespace. Set service shell: true for pipes or redirects.

ports.description: Named map (http: 8000), list, single number, or auto

terraform.description: Read literal env values from this service's Terraform. A string is the path. Explicit environment keys still override these values.

oneOf.description: Path to a .tf file or a directory of .tf files, relative to the repo root

path.description: .tf file or directory of *.tf (that directory only), relative to the repo root

resource.description: Limit the read to resource "type" "name" (type.name) or module "name" (module.name)

attribute.description: Also read this map attribute, such as a locals map name

environments.description: Named environment overlays for this service (e.g. local vs deployed). Switch per service in the TUI, CLI, or MCP.

default_environment.description: Which named environment to use when none is selected for this session. Defaults to the first name alphabetically.

type.description: http | tcp | process | command | grpc (plugins may add more)

grpc_service.description: Health protocol service name for type grpc; empty is overall status

type.description: Built-in user/service_account identity or a type registered by a plugin

dedupe_access_line.description: Drop a plain uvicorn-style access line when the previous event from the same pid already has the same method, path, and status (off by default)

proxy.description: Route fragments merged into the global proxy at load (names become <service> or <service>-<n>)

expose.description: Expose this service through the proxy at a stable, host-based logical address (<service>.local) whose upstream port is resolved at request time. `true`, or an object with match/port overrides. Requires proxy.enabled.

port.description: Named port to forward to (default http)

user.description: Container user (uid or name). Empty keeps the image USER.

memory.description: Memory cap passed to docker/podman --memory. Default 1g when omitted.

cpus.description: CPU cap passed to --cpus. Default 1 when omitted.

read_only.description: When true, the container root filesystem is read-only.

pids_limit.description: PID cap. Default 256 when omitted or 0.

paths.description: Paths relative to the repository root. Never defaults to the whole repo.

inspect_max_bytes.description: Default body cap for inspect-enabled routes whose inspect.max_bytes is 0 or omitted. 0 means 1 MiB. A route that sets max_bytes > 0 wins.

gateway.description: Expose every HTTP-capable service (one with a port named http) through the proxy, as if each declared expose: true. Sugar over per-service expose.

credentials.description: Default authorized_user credentials file for IAP routes that omit auth.credentials (see route.auth.credentials).

transport.description: http (default): shared HTTP/1.1 listener matched by host/path. grpc: a dedicated loopback HTTP/2 (h2c) listener on `listen` that forwards streams to `upstream` over h2+TLS, injecting the route's auth — for gRPC clients (e.g. a Temporal worker) behind IAP.

listen.description: Only for a grpc route: the loopback address the client dials.

service.description: Address the upstream by service name instead of a fixed url; the proxy resolves the service's live port at request time.

port.description: Named port of the referenced service to forward to (default http).

recipe.description: Serve the cached response of a named http recipe instead of forwarding. Synthesized from http.<name>.expose.

client_id.description: Optional OAuth client ID used to mint IAP ID tokens instead of ADC's default client

client_secret.description: Optional OAuth client secret. Use ${NAME} or ${env.NAME} to read from the environment at mint time.

credentials.description: Path to a gcloud authorized_user JSON (client_id/client_secret/refresh_token) used to mint IAP tokens for client_id, instead of default ADC. Keeps ADC intact for GCS/Firestore. ~, absolute, or repo-relative. Falls back to proxy.credentials.

headers.description: Extra request headers injected alongside Authorization. ${token} in a value is replaced with the minted token (e.g. identity-token: ${token}). Applied only on iap/service_account routes.

log_identity.description: On auth.type none only: copy inbound X-Goog-Authenticated-User-Email onto the traffic record as caller_email. Does not mint tokens. Invalid on iap/service_account.

suppress_authorization.description: On iap/service_account only: mint the token and apply auth.headers without writing Authorization: Bearer. Requires auth.headers. Invalid on auth.type none.

response_headers.description: Headers added to every response on this route (overriding the upstream's), e.g. CORS Access-Control-Allow-*. A CORS preflight (OPTIONS with Access-Control-Request-Method) is answered directly with these headers instead of being forwarded to the upstream.

inspect.description: Opt-in capture of request/response bodies on this proxy hop for the traffic inspector. Default off. `true` enables capture with the 1 MiB default cap. Ignored when the proxy is off. Direct sockets that never hit this route are not captured.

strip_prefix.description: When forwarding, strip match.path from the inbound pathname. No-op if match.path is empty. Traffic inspector and proxy logs keep the inbound path. `/my-service` → `/`, `/my-service/foo` → `/foo`; query string is preserved.

routeTransform.description: Rewrites applied to the request before it is forwarded. HTTP routes only.

request_body.description: String or regular-expression replacements applied to the request body, in order, before forwarding. ${NAME} and ${env.NAME} expand in replace and with at request time.

replace.description: Text to find. Literal unless regex is true. ${NAME} / ${env.NAME} expand at request time. ${token} is the minted bearer on iap / service_account routes.

with.description: Literal replacement. $ is not a capture reference. ${NAME} / ${env.NAME} expand at request time. ${token} is the minted bearer on iap / service_account routes.

regex.description: When true, replace is a JavaScript regular expression applied to every match. The pattern must not match an empty string.

routeTimeout.description: Opt-in idle and total deadlines for this hop. Omitted, missing keys, or 0 = unlimited (current behavior). Negative values fail validate. There is no global default — a 47–65s CopilotKit stream must keep working.

idle_ms.description: Abort if no request or response chunk arrives within this many milliseconds. 0 or omitted = unlimited.

total_ms.description: Abort if the hop lasts longer than this many milliseconds. 0 or omitted = unlimited.

ok.description: Non-zero gRPC statuses that are not proxy errors. Matching hops log INFO (or are omitted when log is silent) and do not increment stats().errors.

status.description: Non-zero gRPC status code treated as a non-error on this route (1-16, e.g. 14 for Temporal long-poll).

methods.description: Optional method-name suffixes of :path that match on a / boundary (e.g. PollWorkflowTaskQueue). Omitted = all methods on the route.

log.description: info (default): log the hop at INFO. silent: omit the proxy log line.

routeInspect.description: Opt-in capture of request/response bodies on this proxy hop for the traffic inspector. Default off. Ignored when the proxy is off. Direct sockets that never hit this route are not captured.

max_bytes.description: Per-direction cap on bytes retained for a captured body. 0 uses the default (1 MiB). The full body is always forwarded; only the stored copy is bounded.

capture_sse.description: When true and the response Content-Type is text/event-stream (prefix or charset parameter), store parsed SSE frames instead of the raw event-stream text. Generic events become a JSON array of blank-line-delimited frame strings. OpenAI-shaped chat/completion streams are reassembled into pretty chat.completion JSON. Default false. The forwarded stream is still teed with no extra delay; max_bytes / truncated still apply. Non-SSE responses and request bodies ignore this flag.

grpc.description: Optional gRPC body decode options. Omit decoder to use JSON then proto3 decode_raw.

decoder.description: Named plugin trafficDecoders entry. When omitted, inspect pretty-prints JSON frames or proto3 decode_raw field numbers. Unknown names fail config validate when plugins is empty.

body.description: Raw request body. Mutually exclusive with form.

form.description: application/x-www-form-urlencoded fields. Mutually exclusive with body.

auth.description: Outbound auth for this recipe (same shape as a proxy route). iap/service_account mint ${token}; Authorization is not overwritten when request.headers already sets it.

log_identity.description: On auth.type none only: copy inbound X-Goog-Authenticated-User-Email onto the traffic record as caller_email. Does not mint tokens. Invalid on iap/service_account.

suppress_authorization.description: On iap/service_account only: mint the token and apply auth.headers without writing Authorization: Bearer. Requires auth.headers. Invalid on auth.type none.

outputs.description: Named JSON dotted paths. Reserved names body, url, and status cannot be used.

jwt.description: Cache from JWT exp on string outputs or access_token/id_token/token

expires_in.description: Dotted JSON path to OAuth expires_in seconds

expose.description: Serve the cached recipe response on a local proxy host. Requires proxy.enabled. true, or an object with host/CORS headers.

response_headers.description: Inbound CORS/response headers on the synthesized route

allow_token_body.description: Acknowledge that the exposed cached body may contain token material (access_token/id_token/token output, or a JWT-cached body). Required to expose such a recipe, whose route serves the body with no inbound auth.

enabled.description: Opt-in OTLP/HTTP+JSON receiver. Off by default. Loopback only.
Opt-in loopback telemetry web UI. Off by default. Loopback only. Lifecycle controls via POST /api/control.

llm.description: Opt-in LLM traffic inspector. Off by default. LiteLLM is the first source type; a custom proxy in front of it is reachability, not a new type.

capture_max_bytes.description: Default body cap for sources whose capture.max_bytes is 0 or omitted. 0 means 1 MiB. A source that sets max_bytes > 0 wins.

type.description: Source driver. Built-in: litellm (polls /spend/logs) or proxy (captures OpenAI-compatible bodies off devctl proxy routes named by via.route / via.routes).

service.description: Managed service whose assigned port is the management hop.

endpoint.description: Literal management URL when the source is not a managed service.

path_prefix.description: Mount prefix so spend logs become {prefix}/spend/logs.

llmCostPerToken.description: proxy source only: per-token rates used to estimate call cost as promptTokens * input + completionTokens * output. Both keys required when the block is present. Invalid on litellm and plugin sources.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the LiteLLM master key. Never inline.

header.description: Header for the LiteLLM key. Defaults to Authorization. Use another name when a proxy already owns Authorization.

route.description: Existing proxy.routes[].name. For litellm, the optional management hop that mints the route's identity headers. For type: proxy, singular sugar for one capture route (unioned with via.routes).

routes.description: proxy source only: extra proxy.routes[].name values to capture. Unioned with via.route (singular sugar). Invalid on litellm and plugin sources.

prompts.description: Ingest request/response bodies. Default true. Secrets are still redacted.

max_bytes.description: proxy source only: per-direction cap on bytes retained for a captured body. 0 uses the default (1 MiB). The full body is always forwarded; only the stored copy is bounded.

paths.description: proxy source only: extra inbound path substrings to capture as raw HTTP pairs, in addition to the built-in OpenAI completion paths. Matched case-insensitively as substrings of the request pathname so a route mount prefix does not need repeating. Token usage, model, and finish reason are extracted when present in standard JSON fields; otherwise omitted.

llmCaptureFieldMap.description: proxy source only: JSONPath subset ($.request./$.response., dotted keys, [n] indexes) mapping proprietary bodies onto inspector summary fields. A present mapped value wins over the OpenAI parser; missing/null leaves the default.

cost.description: Gateway cost field. When unset or missing, cost_per_token remains the fallback.
